name: Potassium bitartrate (KC4H5O6), cream of tartar
source: KC4H5O6 molar mass 188.177 g/mol from IUPAC standard atomic weights (K 39.098, C 12.011 x4, H 1.008 x5, O 15.999 x6).
notes: Food-grade cream of tartar is treated as the pure compound, matching sodium-bicarbonate.json's and sucrose.json's own convention for a food-grade-pure mineral salt. Real cream of tartar crystallises from the potassium- and tartaric-acid-rich lees left after winemaking; origin/minerals.ts sources it from a seeded vineyard-region mineral reservoir rather than modelling full fermentation.
